content.value_statement: Campaign results are hard to turn into clear stakeholder reports. This skill structures metrics into audience-specific reports with insights, chart guidance, recommendations, and next steps.
actual_capabilities: Creates executive, client, internal team, and board report structures.
Turns completed campaign metrics into narrative summaries and key learnings.
Pairs metrics with targets, benchmarks, or prior-period context.
Suggests chart types for audience-specific report sections.
Adds recommendations, action items, and next steps for stakeholders.
Uses provided outputs from performance and ROI analysis when available.
limitations: It does not compute raw ROI, ROAS, spend, revenue, or attribution metrics.
It needs campaign metrics, targets, benchmarks, or prior results from the user.
Live platform, CRM, and analytics integrations are optional and not required.
Final reports should be reviewed before client, board, or executive delivery.

use_cases.title: Prepare an executive campaign summary
use_cases.description: Convert final campaign results into a concise summary with ROI, business impact, strategic takeaways, and budget recommendations.

use_cases.title: Create a client-facing results report
use_cases.description: Present campaign performance, creator results, audience insights, and recommended next steps in a polished client report.

use_cases.title: Run an internal campaign retrospective
use_cases.description: Organize detailed learnings, platform performance, content insights, cost analysis, and owner-based action items for future campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Basic campaign report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with core campaign metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a client campaign report for [campaign name]. Use these metrics: [reach], [engagement rate], [spend], [revenue], [ROI], and [top creators].

prompt_templates.title: Executive summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Leadership needs a short results narrative.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an executive summary for [campaign name] covering [period]. Focus on ROI, revenue impact, top wins, risks, and one budget recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Team retrospective
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an internal team report for [campaign name]. Include objectives, KPI results, platform breakdown, content learnings, cost analysis, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Board-ready portfolio report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a board-level quarterly influencer report for [campaign portfolio]. Compare campaigns, summarize business impact, show strategic patterns, and recommend next-quarter priorities.

output_examples.input: Executive report for a holiday campaign with $50K spend, $165K revenue, 3.5M reach, and 15 influencers.
output_examples.output: A concise executive report with bottom-line performance, investment return, target comparisons, strategic highlights, and a recommendation to scale the best-performing creator segment.

output_examples.input: Client report for a launch campaign with reach, engagement, conversions, creator fees, and audience comments.
output_examples.output: A client-facing performance report with campaign overview, results summary, content performance, influencer highlights, audience insights, key learnings, and next steps.

output_examples.input: Internal retrospective for three monthly influencer campaigns across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
output_examples.output: A team report with KPI review, platform breakdown, full roster performance, content themes, budget efficiency, future recommendations, and assigned action items.

best_practices: Provide final metrics, targets, and benchmarks before asking for the report.
Name the audience so the report uses the right depth and tone.
Review recommendations against budget, contracts, and brand constraints before sharing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to calculate missing ROI or attribution from raw data alone.
Do not mix executive, client, and team audiences in one report without sections.
Do not publish generated reports without checking numbers, claims, and next steps.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign dates, audience, spend, revenue, ROI or ROAS, reach, engagement, conversions, creator results, targets, and benchmarks.

faq.question: Can it calculate ROI or ROAS?
faq.answer: No. It expects completed return metrics from the user or from a separate ROI calculator skill.

faq.question: Which report audiences are supported?
faq.answer: It supports executive, client, internal team, and board audiences with different detail levels and recommendations.

faq.question: Does it require live analytics integrations?
faq.answer: No. The skill can work from metrics supplied in the prompt. Connectors are optional data sources.

faq.question: Can it recommend charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests chart types for metrics such as trends, comparisons, funnels, and creator performance.

faq.question: Is it only for influencer marketing?
faq.answer: It is built for influencer marketing, but it also includes guidance for paid ads reporting when completed metrics are available.
